children: Peru's President Keiko Fujimori said on Thursday that the country will receive a total of $16 billion in loans from the Inter-American Development Bank (IDB) and the Development Bank of Latin America and the Caribbean (CAF).
The IDB has approved a $10 billion loan for the country, while the CAF has greenlit a $6 billion package, according to Fujimori, who spoke to journalists at a business forum in Cusco.
Fujimori said the IDB's loan will be dispersed over four years, with $4 billion going to the private sector.
